{{Infobox/Item |type = [[Support item]] |rarity = r |id = VOODOO_DOLL |slayer_level_requirement = Zombie Slayer V |museum = yes |museum_xp = 5 |museum_category = combat |upgradeable = Yes |upgrades_to = Jinxed Voodoo Doll |raw_materials = *40,960 Diamond *40,960 Rotten Flesh *40,752 Pumpkin *320 Pufferfish *256 Flint Arrow *160 Ghast Tear *2 Planks *2 Stick |mat_cost_bazaar = *256 Enchanted Diamond *256 Enchanted Rotten Flesh *1072 Pumpkin *40752 Pumpkin *2 Enchanted Pufferfish *32 Enchanted Ghast Tear }} The '''Voodoo Doll''' is a {{Rare}} item. It is unlocked at {{Coll|Zombie Slayer 5}}. == Obtaining == === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{coll|Zombie Slayer V}} |A1 = Flint Arrow, 64 |B1 = Enchanted Ghast Tear, 32 |C1 = Flint Arrow, 64 |A2 = Enchanted Pufferfish |B2 = Pumpkin Minion IX |C2 = Enchanted Pufferfish |A3 = Flint Arrow, 64 |B3 = Crystallized Heart |C3 = Flint Arrow, 64 |Output = Voodoo Doll }} }} == Usage == {{ItemInfo |rarity = rare |item_ability_name = Acupuncture |item_ability_activation = Right Click |item_ability_description = Shoot arrows from every direction around the targeted monster.
Monsters hit by at least one arrow are slowed and receive {{Red|1,500}} damage/s for {{Green|10s}}. |item_ability_cooldown = 5 |item_ability_mana_cost = 200 |item_ability_intelligence_scaling = 1 }} === Crafting === {{Crafting Usage}} The '''Voodoo Doll'''{{'}}s {{AN|Acupuncture}} ability can be activated by aiming at any entity within a range of {{Green|18}} blocks. Activating the ability summons a volley of {{Green|9}} arrows around the targeted mobs: {{Green|4}} in the cardinal horizontal directions, {{Green|4}} aimed 45˚ downwards in the cardinal diagonal directions, and {{Green|1}} above the mob that travels downward. All mobs that are hit by the volley of arrows take their base damage, as well as an additional {{Red|1,500}} base damage as damage per second over {{Green|10s}}. The ability costs {{Stat|mana|200}} to use and has a {{Green|5s}} cooldown. ==Trivia== *Attempting to feed the {{MobSprite|Siamese Lynx}} a '''Voodoo Doll''' will result in the message {{Rmt|&cThis mob doesn't eat voodoo.}} Previously, the item would be consumed. *The '''Voodoo Doll''' could not be used against players in the [[Colosseum]] prior to its removal. *The '''Voodoo Doll''' can target mobs summoned as the player: this includes but is not limited to Bats spawned from the {{Item|Spirit Sceptre}}, Withers spawned from the {{AN|Witherborn}} full set bonus, minions summoned from the {{AN|Ragnarok}} ability, and mobs summoned with [[Necromancy]]. *The '''Voodoo Doll'''{{'}}s description "Who do you voodoo?" is a reference to the video game [[w:Dead Island|''Dead Island'']], where at the start of the game, the song "''Who Do You Voodoo''" will play. *The cooldown on both voodoo dolls is shared, for example if a player uses a '''Voodoo Doll''', they will have a {{Green|5}} second cooldown on any '''Jinxed Voodoo Doll''' and vice versa. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2019/October 11|[[File:Voodoo Doll.png|26px]] Added '''Voodoo Doll'''.}} {{History|2019/October 15|Reduced [[Slayer]] level requirement by {{Green|1}}, from VI to V.}} {{History|2020/July 1|Fixed magic damage scaling.}} {{History|2021/July 13|The crafting recipe now uses [[Flint Arrow]]s.}} {{history|0.19.1|Fixed color issue in the '''Voodoo Doll''' lore.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Slayer/Zombie}} [[Category:Support Items]]
